questions.question: What is plagiarism in journalism? What is attribution in news writing?
questions.solution_html:
• Plagiarism in journalism is the unethical practice of presenting someone else’s ideas
  • words, or data as one’s own without proper acknowledgment. It damages credibility and
  • violates journalistic ethics. Attribution is the practice of clearly identifying the source of
  • information in a news report. It ensures transparency, builds trust, and allows verification.
  • Example: “According to police officials…” or “The report by WHO states…”.
questions.final_answer: Example: “According to police officials…” or “The report by WHO states…”
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: The visuals on screen influence certain decisions regarding translation for / subtitling and dubbing. Explain.
questions.solution_html:
• Visuals guide translation decisions in audio-visual media. Translators must ensure
  • that the translated dialogue matches
  •  Lip movements (lip-sync) in dubbing
  •  Timing and duration in subtitles
  •  Gestures, expressions, and context visible on screen
  • For example, a character smiling while speaking requires a tone that reflects happiness.
  • Visual cues also reduce the need for verbal explanation, so translations are often shorter and
  • more context-based.
questions.final_answer: more context-based
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Examine the role of suffering in shaping Najeb’s identity in Goat Days .
questions.solution_html:
• Najeb’s suffering in the desert transforms him both physically and psychologically.
  • Initially an ordinary migrant worker, he endures extreme hardship, isolation, and
  • dehumanization.
  • This suffering
  •  Strips away his previous identity
  •  Forces him into survival mode
  •  Builds resilience and inner strength
  • Ultimately, suffering becomes a means of self-realization, shaping him into a stronger
  • more introspective individual.
questions.final_answer: more introspective individual
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Attempt a comparison of Audio Storytelling and Audio Description.
questions.solution_html:
• Audio Storytelling
  •  Created for entertainment or narrative (podcasts, radio plays)
  •  Uses sound effects, music, and narration creatively
  •  Allows imagination and interpretation
  • Audio Description
  •  Created for accessibility (visually impaired audiences)
  •  Describes visual elements objectively
  •  Avoids interpretation and focuses on clarity
  • Key Difference: Storytelling is expressive; Audio Description is informative and
  • neutral.
questions.final_answer: neutral
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Why do literal translation of news headlines fail? Explain with relevant example.
questions.solution_html:
• Headlines may contain pun, idioms and cultural references .
  • News stories use idioms, jokes,wordplay, and cultural references. Direct translation may
  • sound unnatural or confusing .. Example:“the elephant in the room” translated literally may
  • not convey inflation . It may need an equivalent phrase like “the big problem everyone
  • refuses to talk about” Thus, headlines require adaptation, not word-for-word translation
  • Political terms may be different- example, the word terrorist” may be rendered as “militant”
  • “freedom fighter” on the media outlet’s editorial stance
questions.final_answer: “freedom fighter” on the media outlet’s editorial stance
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: For a translator working on dialogues to prepare subtitles, it is impossible to / translate all words. Explain.

questions.question: Briefly describe the development of Audio Description in the 20th century.
questions.solution_html:
• Audio Description began in the late 20th century as a tool for accessibility. It developed
  • through
  •  Theatre experiments in the 1970s
  •  1980s:expansion of AD into live performance
  •  Expansion into television and film :1990s (Descriptive Video Service was launched
  • by PBSin 1990
  •  Institutional support and standardization
  • By the end of the century, it became an important accessibility practice in media
  • industries.
questions.final_answer: industries

questions.question: Why is The Bicycle Thieves considered a successful adaptation?
questions.solution_html:
• In Bicycle Thieves, the translation from words to images is not mechanical but poetic
  •  Shot Composition: A low-angle shot can imbue a character with power; a close-up
  • can reveal unspoken emotions.
  •  Framing and Composition: The recurring wide shots of Rome's streets situate the
  • characters within the social landscape, underscoring the systemic nature of poverty.
  •  Close-ups bring us into intimate contact with Antonio's growing despair and Bruno's
  • silent resilience, replacing narrative exposition with visual empathy.
  •  Camera Movement: The tracking shots following Antonio and Bruno through
  • crowded streets mirror the forward drive of the written narrative, but with a sensory
  • dimension - the shuffle of feet, the ambient chatter - that no paragraph could replicate.
  •  Editing Rhythm: Pacing controls emotional impact - long takes for contemplation and
  • rapid cuts for urgency.
  •  Sound and Silence: Dialogue, music and silences become narrative devices. Silence
  • carries the weight of a thousand words.
  •  It captures the emotional core of the original story
  •  Uses realistic visuals and performances
  •  Adapts content to suit cinematic storytelling
  • (5x6=30)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: This question has two parts. Answer both. Each part gets equal marks. / a) Discuss the language of news and its distinctive features. b) You are a sub editor in an Indian English newspaper. The following news item has been received from an international news agency. Rewrite and adapt the report in English making it clear for Indian readers. Maintain objectivity and factual accuracy. Ensure brevity without losing essential information. Provide brief explanations within the text for unfamiliar references. Identify and explain culturally specific terms unfamiliar to Indian readers. Remove idioms or expressions that may not be understood. Write a suitable headline. AGENCY COPY Madrid, July 22 (AFP) – Spain’s Parliament approved a housing reform package aimed at controlling rent increases in major urban centres where affordability has declined. The law allows regional governments to designate high demand areas where rent caps may be introduced. Provisions for tenant protections have been expanded. The government stated that low income households must be supported amid rising living costs. Property developers have warned that construction activity could be slowed if profitability declines. Implementation will be overseen by regional authorities.
questions.solution_html:
• (a). Language of news and its features
  • News language is: Simple and direct, Neutral and impersonal tone, Active voice, Short
  • sentences and paragraph, Concrete and specific
  • It prioritizes clarity, accuracy, and immediacy.
  • (b). Adapted News Report (Any clear answer can be awarded marks)
  • Headline
  • Spain Approves New Law to Control Rising Urban Rents
  • Report
  • Madrid, July 22 – Spain’s Parliament has approved a new housing reform law aimed at
  • controlling rising rents in major cities, where housing has become increasingly unaffordable.
  • The law allows regional governments to identify high-demand areas and introduce rent limits.
  • It also strengthens protections for tenants.
  • The government said the move is necessary to support low-income families facing increasing
  • living costs. However, property developers have warned that the new rules may reduce
  • construction activity if profits decline.
  • The implementation of the law will be managed by regional authorities.
  • (15 x 2 = 30)
questions.final_answer: Option . Language of news and its features
